FAQ

Search questions, answered clearly

Can I use keywords other than LINK?

Yes. Each campaign can use multiple keywords such as PRICE, SHOP, GUIDE, PLAN, WAITLIST, TOUR, or your own phrase.

Does OpenReply send a normal Instagram DM?

It sends a Meta-compliant private reply triggered by the comment event, using the Instagram comment ID.
